ksTFL converts JSON report specifications into deterministic DOCX output
with a C++ renderer. This document maps its modules, pipeline phases, and
data structures.

<div class="self-numbered" aria-hidden="true"></div>

## 1. End-to-End Architecture

```
R API
  -> R layer serializes spec/template/data to JSON (jsonlite)
  -> src/rcpp_bindings.cpp
  -> kstfl::Renderer

Renderer pipeline
  Parse -> Resolve -> Model -> Measure -> Paginate -> Emit -> Package

Core modules
  json_parser.cpp      : spec/template/data parsing
  units.cpp            : Length parsing and EMU/dxa conversion backbone
  style_types.cpp      : style-merge machinery + OOXML enum lookup tables
  style_resolver.cpp   : style cascade + page/width resolution
  logical_table.cpp    : header grid + logical row stream + styleRows actions
  font_scanner.cpp     : system font discovery + fallback resolution
  text_measurer.cpp    : HarfBuzz-based deterministic measurement
  paginator.cpp        : vertical and horizontal pagination
  docx_*.cpp           : OOXML emission for document parts
  zip_writer.cpp       : DOCX ZIP packaging
```

## 2. C++ Module Map

### 2.1 Entry and orchestration

-   src/rcpp_bindings.cpp
    -   render_docx_impl()
    -   render_docx_from_strings_impl()
-   src/kstfl/renderer.cpp
    -   Renderer::render()
    -   Renderer::render_from_strings()
-   src/cpp_tests.cpp
    -   In-package C++ self-tests (units, inline_parser, xml_writer,
        format validator), driven from testthat via `.Call`

### 2.2 Parsing and schema model

-   src/kstfl/json_parser.cpp
    -   parse_spec_json_string()
    -   parse_template_json_string()
    -   parse_data_json_string()
-   src/kstfl/types.h
    -   Complete domain model (page config, styles, table model,
        pagination model)

### 2.3 Layout and table engine

-   src/kstfl/style_resolver.cpp
    -   resolve_page_config()
    -   resolve_table_width()
    -   resolve_column_widths()
    -   style cascade resolution helpers
-   src/kstfl/logical_table.cpp
    -   LogicalTableBuilder::build()
    -   build_header_grid(), build_data_rows()
    -   apply_dedupe() runs as its own pass; apply_style_rows() then
        interleaves c_clear, c_glue, c_merge, c_style, c_addrow, and
        c_pageBreak by sequence number; detect_grouping_boundaries()
-   src/kstfl/inline_parser.cpp
    -   inline markup extraction (`<b> <i> <u> <s> <br> <sup> <sub> <p>`)
        feeding vertAlign/bold/italic/strike runs to the emitter

### 2.4 Font discovery, measurement, and pagination

-   src/kstfl/font_scanner.cpp
    -   Platform-specific system font directory enumeration
    -   FreeType-based font family/style classification
    -   Global font path map (populated at package load, re-populated by
        tfl_rescan_fonts())
    -   Target font resolution with fallback assignment
-   src/kstfl/font_cache.cpp
    -   FreeType/HarfBuzz font loading + metrics cache
    -   Dynamic font resolution via scanner's global path map
-   src/kstfl/text_measurer.cpp
    -   TextMeasurer::measure_plain()
    -   measure_cell() with wrapping, spacing, margins, orientation
        support
-   src/kstfl/paginator.cpp
    -   Paginator::paginate()
    -   build_segments(), compute_available_height()
    -   compute_row_heights(), compute_segment_row_heights()

### 2.5 DOCX emission and packaging

-   src/kstfl/docx_emitter.cpp (top-level emission orchestration)
-   Document parts: src/kstfl/docx_document.cpp, docx_content.cpp,
    docx_page.cpp, docx_table.cpp, docx_styles.cpp, docx_sections.cpp,
    docx_layout.cpp, docx_drawing.cpp, docx_toc.cpp
-   src/kstfl/docx_metadata.cpp
    -   [Content_Types].xml, .rels, document rels, font table, settings
-   src/kstfl/docx_packager.cpp
    -   Assembles and writes all parts through ZipWriter (media files
        included)
-   src/kstfl/xml_writer.cpp
-   src/kstfl/zip_writer.cpp

## 3. Detailed Rendering Pipeline

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Phase 1: Parse                                                        │
│   parse_template_bundle()                                             │
│   parse_spec_json_string() -> TFLDocument                             │
│   parse_data_json_string()  -> DataTable                              │
│   resolve figure media paths for Figure specs                         │
│                                                                       │
│ Phase 1b: Enforce isColBreak layout constraints                       │
│   for specs with isColBreak columns: force                            │
│   allow_row_break_across_pages=false, repeat_header_on_each_page=true │
│   (warn if template values were overridden)                           │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Phase 2: Initialize text subsystem                                    │
│   FontCache: load configured font dirs and fallback font              │
│   TextMeasurer(font_cache)                                            │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Phase 3: Per-spec processing                                          │
│                                                                       │
│   3a) Resolve                                                         │
│      StyleResolver(template, spec_styles)                             │
│      resolve_page_config()                                            │
│      resolve_table_width()                                            │
│      resolve_column_widths()                                          │
│                                                                       │
│   3b) Model                                                           │
│      LogicalTableBuilder::build()                                     │
│      - header grid + vMerge metadata                                  │
│      - logical data rows                                              │
│      - dedupe pass, then styleRows actions in sequence order:         │
│        c_clear, c_glue, c_merge, c_style, c_addrow, c_pageBreak       │
│                                                                       │
│   3c) Measure                                                         │
│      Header rows: vMerge-aware 2-pass height balancing                │
│      Body cells: TextMeasurer::measure_plain()                        │
│      - inline markup parsing                                          │
│      - HarfBuzz shaping                                               │
│      - deterministic wrapping and line-height math                    │
│                                                                       │
│   3d) Paginate                                                        │
│      Paginator::paginate()                                            │
│      - build_segments(): split before isColBreak columns, drop        │
│        invisible columns, repeat isID columns in every segment        │
│      - compute_row_heights(): baseline full-table heights             │
│      - compute_segment_column_widths(): segment width scaling         │
│      - compute_segment_row_heights(): per-segment row heights         │
│      - compute static blocks: titles/subtitles/header/footer/notes    │
│      - vertical fill + LastPage post-pass (deterministic mode only)   │
│      - row-break mode keeps natural flow; no LastPage reshuffling     │
│                                                                       │
│   3e) Dedupe restoration                                              │
│      Restore deduped values at page boundaries                        │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Phase 4: Emit and package DOCX                                        │
│   DocxEmitter::emit()                                                 │
│   - document.xml, styles.xml, rels, header/footer parts               │
│   - page/section assembly, table/header/body emission                 │
│   - optional TOC                                                      │
│   ZipWriter: package all OOXML parts into .docx                       │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 4. Core Data Structures

Defined primarily in src/kstfl/types.h.

-   **Units and geometry**: `Length`, `PageConfig`, `PageMargins`,
    `PageMarginsOverride`
-   **Style system**: `FontProps`, `ParagraphProps`, `TableCellProps`,
    `StyleDef`, `StylesTemplate`
-   **Table model**: `ColumnSpec`, `StubColumn`, `TextGroup`,
    `LogicalCell`, `LogicalRow`, `HeaderGrid`
-   **Pagination model**: `PageSlice`, `HorizontalSegment`,
    `PaginationResult`

## 5. Text and Font Subsystem

-   `FontCache` reads font metrics from OS/2 tables, with `hhea` as fallback,
    to match Word line-height behavior.
-   `TextMeasurer` uses HarfBuzz shaping for deterministic run widths and
    wrapping.
-   Cell height includes paragraph spacing, wrapped line heights, and
    top/bottom cell margins.
-   Rotated text paths (`btLr`, `tbRl`) are handled explicitly.

## 6. Pagination Internals

-   Vertical pagination starts from usable page height, then subtracts the
    safety margin, header/footer overflow, titles, table header, and reserved
    footnote space.
-   Horizontal segmentation starts a new segment at `isColBreak`, repeats
    `isID` columns in each segment, and scales non-ID columns to the remaining
    width. When `isColBreak` is active, the renderer also enforces
    `allow_row_break_across_pages = FALSE` and
    `repeat_header_on_each_page = TRUE`.
-   Last-page footnotes use two paths: deterministic mode keeps them on the
    true final page through a post-pass, while row-break mode keeps natural
    Word flow and skips that reshuffling.
-   Row heights are tracked both at the full-table level and at the
    segment-specific level so emitted `trHeight` values remain exact.
-   Warning thresholds compare against the physical page body height, while
    pagination still uses a safety margin for conservative fitting.
-   Page totals returned to R subtract one page per continuousSection seam,
    since a joined spec does not start a new page.

## 7. Style Resolution Cascade

The renderer applies styles in this effective order. Every later layer
overrides earlier ones field-by-field — including the structural layer,
which is applied early in the merge chain rather than enforced last:

1.  Template default text style
2.  Region style (tableHeader, tableBody, titles, subtitles, footnotes)
3.  Template row defaults
4.  Structural styles (header/body structural constraints)
5.  Column labelStyleRef or valueStyleRef
6.  Row action style (styleRows c_style)
7.  Merge/action style overrides
8.  AddRow style overrides
9.  tableStyle.cellDefaults.vertical_alignment — fills vertical alignment
    only when no higher layer set it (lowest precedence)

Inline markup (`<b>`, `<i>`, `<sup>`, ...) applies as run-level overrides
at emission, on top of the resolved cell style.

## 8. R/C++ Integration

-   Exported functions in src/rcpp_bindings.cpp
    -   render_docx_impl(...)
    -   render_docx_from_strings_impl(...)
    -   init_font_registry_impl(fallback_font_dir, extra_dirs) — scans
        font directories and fills the global path map; called at package
        load (.onLoad) and by tfl_rescan_fonts()
    -   get_font_dirs_impl() — returns the directories found by the last
        scan
-   Registration in src/init.cpp and src/RcppExports.cpp.
-   Error propagation uses RenderError and Rcpp::stop().

## 9. Build and Dependencies

-   Language standard: C++20
-   C++20 features used:
    -   `operator<=>` (three-way comparison) for `Length`
    -   Concepts (`Mergeable`) constraining style merge templates
        (style_types.cpp)
    -   `constexpr std::array` lookup tables for OOXML enum conversions
        (style_types.cpp)
    -   `std::ranges::sort`, `std::ranges::any_of`,
        `std::ranges::transform`
    -   `using enum` in switch statements
    -   `std::to_chars` for double formatting
    -   `[[nodiscard]]` on value-returning functions in the layout/style
        core (style_resolver.h, text_measurer.h, types.h); not applied
        uniformly across every header yet
-   Core dependencies:
    -   HarfBuzz (vendored source)
    -   FreeType2 (vendored source)
    -   minizip (vendored source)
    -   zlib
    -   nlohmann/json (vendored)
    -   Rcpp
-   Build files:
    -   src/Makevars
    -   src/Makevars.win
-   Linux build model:
    -   `src/Makevars` always compiles vendored HarfBuzz, FreeType, and
        minizip sources under `src/vendor/`
    -   Vendored libraries build as single-compilation-unit wrappers
        (`ft_all.c`, the `harfbuzz.cc` amalgamation, `mz_all.c`);
        HarfBuzz is trimmed with HB_NO_SUBSET/HB_NO_COLOR/HB_NO_PAINT/
        HB_NO_STYLE and compiled as C++17
    -   nlohmann/json is header-only, pulled in via the vendor include
        path
    -   No `pkg-config` probe or system-library fallback is used on Linux
    -   Windows continues to use `src/Makevars.win` with Rtools-provided static libraries

## 10. Practical Trace (One Table Spec)

```
spec json + data json + template json
  -> Renderer::render_from_strings()
  -> StyleResolver::resolve_*()
  -> LogicalTableBuilder::build()
  -> TextMeasurer::measure_plain()
  -> Paginator::paginate()
      -> segment row heights
  -> DocxEmitter::emit_table_row()
      -> exact trHeight from segment.row_heights
  -> ZipWriter::close()
  -> output.docx
```
